refsynopsisdiv.title: Syntax
refsynopsisdiv.synopsis: img_out = dilate(img_in, element[, anchor[, iterations[, borderType[, borderValue]]]])

listitem.para: Structuring element used for erosion (double matrix or Mat) (default 3x3 matrix).
Position of the anchor in the element (double 1x2 matrix) (default the anchor is at the element center).
number of times erosion is applied (double).

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: erode dilates an image using the specified structuring element giving the pixel neighborhood over which the maximum is taken.
